import importlib.util,random,time
from fractions import Fraction
sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('s','/workspace/submission/main.py');s=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp);sp.loader.exec_module(s)
random.seed(3)
# 64 core edges with random ~600-digit denominators, repeated queried many times
edges=[(1+2*i,2+2*i) for i in range(64)]
marg={}
for e in edges:
    d=random.getrandbits(2000)|1
    ns=[random.randrange(d) for _ in range(3)]
    ssum=sum(ns)
    marg[e]=tuple(Fraction(x,ssum) for x in ns)
queries=[]
for qi in range(512):
    # all 64 links (65 vertices)
    path=[1]
    for e in edges:path.append(e[1])
    queries.append((f'q{qi}',path,(1,2)))
t=time.time();o=s.score_queries(queries,set(),{}, {},marg);print('time',time.time()-t,len(o),o[0]['score'],o[0]['full'])
PY
